hypothesis.claim: Setting the existing file-backed PPM residency budget to zero preserves exact payload bytes while reducing process-tree RSS below the strict limit.
hypothesis.falsification: Reject if integer probabilities or payload differ from the matched clean control, inverse/repeat fails, package delta exceeds 65,536 bytes, or any process tree crosses 9,765,625 KiB.

changedMechanism: Set CMIX_PPMD_RSS_BUDGET_MB=0ULL so the unchanged PPM shared mapping is evicted every existing 5,000-byte check interval.
invariants: No context capacity, replacement policy, state byte, probability, or arithmetic operation changes.
The PPM backing file and all later page faults contain the exact parent model state.
Encoder and bare decoder use the same compile-time residency policy.
Exact repeat payload/archive and canonical inverse remain mandatory.
Process-tree peak RSS must remain below 9,765,625 KiB.

controls.definition: Matched clean non-PGO source build with the parent 9,216 MiB trigger.
Matched source build with compile-time PPM RSS budget zero.

population.unit: raw enwik9 bytes encoded through the complete reversible pipeline
population.selection: Opening 250KB build/identity diagnostic followed by separately frozen larger memory populations.
population.coordinate: Complete cmix-obias pipeline with identical corpus and package contract.

availableInformation: Current process RSS and the existing fixed 5,000-byte PPM purge check.
The file-backed PPM heap containing decoder-visible modeled state.
forbiddenInformation: Future corpus symbols or encoder-only model state.
Any context-table capacity or modeled-state change.

measurements.definition: Restored bytes exactly equal the frozen population.
Two N encodes produce identical payload and archive bytes.
P and N arithmetic payload bytes and probability receipts are identical.
Every N process-tree peak is below 9,765,625 KiB.
N incremental required package bytes are at most 65,536.
All bounded scratch is removed after the terminal receipt.
